name: MCN2
tagline: Dual-HDMI Intel mini PC with DDR4 and optional 2.5-inch storage
description: MCN2 combines Intel N95 / N100 / N150 options, one DDR4-3200 SO-DIMM slot for 8-16 GB and dual HDMI 2.0 outputs. Four 10 Gbps USB 3.2 ports and Gigabit Ethernet provide wired connections. M.2 SATA and an optional 7 mm 2.5-inch HDD / SSD offer storage choices, with Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 4.2 and TPM 2.0 support.
featureHeading: Compact desktop connections and clear configuration choices
advantageSummary: Compare the memory, display, storage and wireless options for this model, including TPM 2.0 support and the listed power and environment limits.
